endpoints.name: Accounts
endpoints.description: The customer organisations contacts belong to, with name, account URL and their created dates. The company-level dimension in ActiveCampaign's CRM.

endpoints.name: Account
endpoints.description: One account by id.

endpoints.name: Account Associations
endpoints.description: The links between contacts and accounts, each with the contact's job title. How people are attached to companies, which neither record states alone.

endpoints.name: Account Association
endpoints.description: One account association by id.

endpoints.name: Custom account fields
endpoints.description: The custom field definitions for accounts.

endpoints.name: Custom account field
endpoints.description: One account field definition by id.

endpoints.name: Custom account field values
endpoints.description: The custom field values on accounts, keyed by field id.

endpoints.name: Custom account field value
endpoints.description: One account field value by id.

endpoints.name: Addresses
endpoints.description: The physical sender addresses used in campaign footers, as anti-spam law requires. Configuration.

endpoints.name: Address
endpoints.description: One address by id.

endpoints.name: Automations
endpoints.description: The automation workflows defined, with name, status and entry conditions. WHERE MOST EMAIL ACTUALLY GETS SENT in an ActiveCampaign account -- campaign volume alone understates sending, because automations run continuously in response to behaviour.

endpoints.name: Brandings
endpoints.description: The branding configurations available for emails and pages. Presentation.

endpoints.name: Branding
endpoints.description: One branding by id.

endpoints.name: Calendar feeds
endpoints.description: The calendar feeds published from the account.

endpoints.name: Calendar
endpoints.description: One calendar feed by id.

endpoints.name: Campaigns
endpoints.description: The email campaigns, with name, type, status, send date, and the counts of sends, opens, clicks, bounces and unsubscribes. The performance table. Status separates drafts and scheduled sends from those actually delivered, so counting all rows counts campaigns that never went out.

endpoints.name: Campaign links
endpoints.description: The links in one campaign with their click counts. Requires a campaign id. Which content drew the response, as opposed to whether anything did.

endpoints.name: Campaign
endpoints.description: One campaign by id, with its full statistics.

endpoints.name: Messages
endpoints.description: The message templates campaigns send -- the subject, sender and content. A campaign references a message, so this is what turns a campaign into readable content.

endpoints.name: Message
endpoints.description: One message by id.

endpoints.name: Contacts
endpoints.suffix: 3/contacts?ids={IDs?}&datetime={Date Time?}&email={Email?}&email_like={Email Like?}&exclude={Exclude?}&formid={Form ID?}&id_greater={Greater Than ID?}&id_less={Less Than ID?}&listid={List ID?}&organization={Organization?}&search={Search?}&segmentid={Segment ID?}&seriesid={Series ID?}&status={Status?:-1|0|1|2|3}&tagid={Tag ID?}&filters[created_before]={Created Before?}&filters[created_after]={Created After?}&filters[updated_before]={Updated Before?}&filters[updated_after]={Updated After?}&waitid={Wait ID?}&in_group_lists={In Group Lists?:true|false}
endpoints.description: The contacts in the account, with email, name, phone, the customer account, and their created and updated dates. The central table. NOTE THE CUSTOM FIELD SPLIT, which is the shape of this whole API: a contact's custom values do NOT come back on the contact -- they live in Custom contact field values, keyed by field id, and Custom contact fields is what names those ids. Nothing is readable from one table alone.

endpoints.name: Contact
endpoints.description: One contact by id.

endpoints.name: Contact's automations
endpoints.description: The automations one contact is currently in, with their status and the step reached. Requires a contact id. WHERE A CONTACT SITS IN THE MARKETING PROCESS -- the contact record itself says nothing about it.

endpoints.name: Contact's score values
endpoints.description: The lead scores of one contact. Requires a contact id. Scores are computed from behaviour, so this is the engagement measure the contact record lacks.

endpoints.name: Contact automations
endpoints.description: Every contact-to-automation membership on the account. The account-wide view of who is in what, and the basis for automation funnel analysis.

endpoints.name: Contact automation
endpoints.description: One contact automation record by id.

endpoints.name: Custom contact fields
endpoints.description: The custom field DEFINITIONS for contacts, with their titles, types and options. The decoder half of the split.

endpoints.name: Custom contact field
endpoints.description: One contact field definition by id.

endpoints.name: Custom contact field values
endpoints.description: The custom field VALUES, each pairing a contact, a field id and a value. The data half. Join to the definitions to make it readable.

endpoints.name: Custom contact field value
endpoints.description: One contact field value by id.

endpoints.name: Deals
endpoints.suffix: /3/deals?filters[search]={Search?}&filters[search_field]={Search Field?}&filters[title]={Title?}&filters[stage]={Stage?}&filters[group]={Group?}&filters[status]={Status?}&filters[owner]={Owner?}&filters[nextdate_range]={Nextdate Range?}&filters[tag]={Tag?}&filters[tasktype]={Tasktype?}&filters[created_before]={Created Before?}&filters[created_after]={Created After?}&filters[updated_before]={Updated Before?}&filters[updated_after]={Updated After?}&filters[organization]={Organization?}&filters[minimum_value]={Minimum Value?}&filters[maximum_value]={Maximum Value?}&filters[score_greater_than]={Score Greater Than?}&filters[score_less_than]={Score Less Than?}&filters[score]={Score?}
endpoints.description: The sales opportunities, with title, value, currency, the contact and account, the pipeline and stage, owner, status and expected close date. The CRM side of ActiveCampaign. Custom values follow the same split as contacts -- Custom deal field values holds them, Custom deal fields names them.

endpoints.name: Deal
endpoints.description: One deal by id.

endpoints.name: Pipelines
endpoints.description: The deal pipelines defined. Most accounts run more than one and stages are not comparable between them, so a funnel question has to name the pipeline.

endpoints.name: Pipeline
endpoints.description: One pipeline by id.

endpoints.name: Stages
endpoints.description: The stages within pipelines, with their order and the pipeline each belongs to. The dimension a funnel breakdown joins to.

endpoints.name: Stage
endpoints.description: One stage by id.

endpoints.name: Custom deal fields
endpoints.description: The custom field definitions for deals.

endpoints.name: Custom deal field
endpoints.description: One deal field definition by id.

endpoints.name: Custom deal field values
endpoints.description: The custom field values on deals, keyed by field id.

endpoints.name: Custom deal field value
endpoints.description: One deal field value by id.

endpoints.name: Secondary contacts
endpoints.description: The additional contacts linked to deals beyond the primary one. A deal names one contact; this is everyone involved.

endpoints.name: Secondary contact
endpoints.description: One deal-to-contact link by id.

endpoints.name: Connections
endpoints.description: The e-commerce store connections configured, with their service and status. WHETHER THE STORE IS CONNECTED DECIDES whether the e-commerce tables have anything in them, so an empty result there is usually an integration fact rather than an absence of sales.

endpoints.name: Connection
endpoints.description: One connection by id.

endpoints.name: E-Commerce customers
endpoints.description: The customers synced from a connected store, each linked to an ActiveCampaign contact and carrying their store-side identifiers. The bridge between marketing contacts and purchase behaviour.

endpoints.name: E-Commerce customer
endpoints.description: One e-commerce customer by id.

endpoints.name: E-Commerce orders
endpoints.description: The orders synced from connected stores, with the customer, total, currency, date and source. REVENUE ATTRIBUTION LIVES HERE: campaigns and automations can be tied to orders, which is the only way to connect email to money in ActiveCampaign.

endpoints.name: E-Commerce order
endpoints.description: One order by id.

endpoints.name: E-Commerce order products
endpoints.description: The line items across orders. What was actually bought, as opposed to the order total.

endpoints.name: E-Commerce order products for a specific E-Commerce Order
endpoints.description: The line items of one order. Requires an order id.

endpoints.name: E-Commerce order product
endpoints.description: One order line item by id.

endpoints.name: Forms
endpoints.description: The signup forms, with their fields and the lists they feed. The acquisition side, and the explanation for where contacts came from.

endpoints.name: Form
endpoints.description: One form by id.

endpoints.name: Lists
endpoints.description: The mailing lists, with name, subscriber counts and the sender details. The audience container.

endpoints.name: List
endpoints.description: One list by id.

endpoints.name: Contact Notes
endpoints.description: The notes on one contact. Requires a contact id.

endpoints.name: Note
endpoints.description: One note by id.

endpoints.name: Organizations
endpoints.description: The organisations defined for user grouping. Distinct from Accounts, which are customer companies; these group the account's own staff.

endpoints.name: Organization
endpoints.description: One organization by id.

endpoints.name: Saved responses
endpoints.description: The canned replies available. Which exist says a good deal about the standard cases handled.

endpoints.name: Saved response
endpoints.description: One saved response by id.

endpoints.name: Scores
endpoints.description: The scoring rules defined, each with the conditions that add or subtract points. The definitions behind a score value, and where the business's own idea of a qualified lead is written down.

endpoints.name: Score
endpoints.description: One score rule by id.

endpoints.name: Segments
endpoints.description: The segments defined, each with the conditions describing an audience. Their conditions state the organisation's own definitions of terms like engaged or lapsed.

endpoints.name: Segment
endpoints.description: One segment by id.

endpoints.name: Event tracking status
endpoints.description: Whether custom event tracking is enabled. Event data is only collected when it is, so this explains an empty event vocabulary.

endpoints.name: Names of tracked events
endpoints.description: The custom event names being recorded. Events are whatever the site's own code sends, so this is the only way to learn what exists before segmenting on it.

endpoints.name: Site tracking status
endpoints.description: Whether site visit tracking is enabled.

endpoints.name: Whitelisted site tracking domains
endpoints.description: The domains site tracking accepts. Visits from anywhere else are not recorded, which is a common cause of gaps.

endpoints.name: Tags
endpoints.description: The tags defined. In ActiveCampaign tags drive automation entry and segmentation, so this list is effectively the catalogue of states the business tracks.

endpoints.name: Tag
endpoints.description: One tag by id.

endpoints.name: Tasks
endpoints.suffix: /3/dealTasks?filters[title]={Title?}&filters[reltype]={Relating Object?}&filters[relid]={Relational Object ID?}&filters[status]={Status?}&filters[note]={Note?}&filters[duedate]={Due Date?}&filters[d_tasktypeid]={Task Type?}&filters[userid]={User ID?}&filters[due_after]={Due After?}&filters[due_before]={Due Before?}&filters[duedate_range]={Due Date Range?}
endpoints.description: The tasks attached to deals, with due date, type, owner and completion. The forward-looking sales work.

endpoints.name: Task
endpoints.description: One deal task by id.

endpoints.name: Task types
endpoints.description: The task types configured -- call, email, meeting. The decoder for a task's type and the dimension that turns task volume into activity mix.

endpoints.name: Task type
endpoints.description: One task type by id.

endpoints.name: Template
endpoints.description: One email template by id. The design layer beneath messages.

endpoints.name: Users
endpoints.description: The staff users of the account, with name, email and group. Every deal carries an owner, so this is the dimension per-person performance joins to.

endpoints.name: User by id
endpoints.description: One user by id.

endpoints.name: User by email
endpoints.description: One user by email address. The lookup when the id is unknown.

endpoints.name: User by username
endpoints.description: One user by username.

endpoints.name: Logged-in user
endpoints.description: The account the credentials belong to. One record, always the caller.

endpoints.name: Groups
endpoints.description: The permission groups users belong to, each with what its members may see. The reason two users get different row counts.

endpoints.name: Group
endpoints.description: One group by id.

endpoints.name: Webhooks
endpoints.description: The webhooks configured, with the events each subscribes to. Integration configuration.

endpoints.name: Webhook events
endpoints.description: The event types a webhook can subscribe to. Reference data.

endpoints.name: Webhook
endpoints.description: One webhook by id.
